classification.difficultyReason: Select SAS similarity from two proportional side pairs and the vertically opposite included angle, then use the established correspondence to find the remaining side.

content.prompt: Show that $\triangle ABC\sim\triangle DBE$. Hence, determine the value of $x$.

spec.description: Hourglass triangles with A–B–D and E–B–C collinear. No parallel arrows are supplied. Decorative pink fill omitted.
spec.answerVisibility: All six given or unknown side labels visible; no answer supplied.

answer.short:
$\triangle ABC\sim\triangle DBE$ (SAS); $x=16$.

The sides enclosing the vertically opposite angles have equal ratios.
answer.worked:
$\angle ABC=\angle DBE$ (vertically opposite angles).

$$\begin{align*}\frac{AB}{DB}&=\frac{15}{10}=\frac{3}{2}\\\frac{CB}{BE}&=\frac{18}{12}=\frac{3}{2}\end{align*}$$

Therefore, $\triangle ABC\sim\triangle DBE$ (SAS).

$$\begin{align*}\frac{AC}{DE}&=\frac{AB}{DB}\\\frac{24}{x}&=\frac{15}{10}\\\frac{24}{x}&=\frac{3}{2}\\3x&=48\\x&=16\end{align*}$$
